correction.behavior: When a traced path is discovered from the higher node ID to the lower node ID, endpoints are swapped and the embedded polyline is reversed before TopologyEdge construction.
correction.identity_policy: The canonical edge_id is retained; no synthetic reverse edge ID is introduced.

roll_pi.reason: frames.yaml declares frame names but the checkout has no measured Livox-to-base extrinsic matrix or hardware manifest proving an inverted installation.
required_evidence: ROS TF authority and frame-direction inspection

support_shadows.reason: Photographic geometry can motivate a fixture, but cannot establish angular blind sectors, timing, reflectance or coverage bounds.
required_evidence: coverage report across height and azimuth

self_radius_m.reason: P2.3 explicitly labels self-radius and footprint values as uncalibrated development profile values; the mask must not be promoted to physical proof.

opponent_coasting.reason: EKF coasting behavior belongs to P4 and does not certify P3 map coverage or physical capture visibility.

verification.target_command: Set-Location hsl_core; python -m pytest tests/test_topology.py tests/test_topology_extraction.py -q
